prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square mature painterly mythology encyclopedia artwork. BERGSRÅ, female Nordic mountain spirit in the documented woman-in-white manifestation: one mature human-shaped woman with composed inviting expression, long ordinary brown hair, entirely normal human face and hands, modest plain flowing white dress and pale mantle. Standing just inside an enormous Nordic mountain cave with one open hand gesturing gently inward. Cold rocky walls show natural glints of ore and mineral seams, beyond doorway dark northern pine forest in dusk. Shadowy cave conveys an Otherworld mountain home and ore sovereignty. No wings, claws, horns, pointy ears, hollow tree-back, tail, crystal skin, rock growths or anatomical deformity, no sexual scene, food banquet, other beings or readable symbols. Elegant detailed brushwork with atmospheric depth, restrained antique-gold light and forest-green shadows. Main heads and hands entirely contained in frame. No text, border, signature, watermark, gore, nudity or unintended extra limbs.
